Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Discovery recap + quick check on fit and next step

Hi Alex / Samira —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have the same page and a suggested next step: 

Summary (high level)
- Current setup: BrightPath runs inference for patient triage and clinical summarization on a mix of on-prem and cloud GPUs.
- Primary goals: reduce per-token inference cost, stabilize 99th%-ile latency for the triage endpoint, and add a rollback-safe canary for model updates.
- Constraints: SOC2 evidence required, network egress restrictions for PHI, and procurement prefers a single annual contract.

What we can help with (how Redwood fits)
- Dedicated pools for predictable throughput and VPC/private deployment options for regulated workloads.
- Smart routing + prefix caching to cut token costs on repetitive prompts.
- Rollout tools (canary/A-B + automatic fallback) to reduce risk when updating models.

Proposed next step
- 15–20 minute technical sync with your infra lead to validate network/KMS needs and confirm a pilot scope (sample SLA and pilot sizing).

Attachments
- BrightPath-discovery-recap.pdf [attachment stub] — one-page summary and proposed pilot scope.

If that sounds right, I can book the sync for next week. If priorities shifted, a quick note on timing works too.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the follow-up and the clear recap. We’re still digesting options after a busy quarter-end. Short answers for your checklist: 
- Infra sync: yes, but likely after our procurement window closes mid-August.
- Timing constraints: procurement is targeting vendor shortlist by Aug 20; we won’t finalize until September.
- Fit feedback: the capabilities you outlined look relevant, but we need to validate on-prem network/PHI workflow before moving to pilot.

If you can send a short note on how Redwood handles PHI in private deployments (high level SOC2/HSM/KMS touchpoints), I’ll share with our security team. Otherwise, let’s revisit week of Aug 23 for scheduling.

Thanks —
